name: MLSC 4301
title: Clinical Chemistry and Instrumentation
description: Manual and automated methods for the biochemical analysis of blood and body fluids; principles of operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of laboratory instruments. Evaluation of test results in normal and diseased states. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: MCB 2000; open only to Medical Laboratory Sciences majors, others with consent of Program Director.
